label: two-layer groups in automatic pipeline
hypothesis: Amortize pipeline producer/event/copy coordination across two adjacent layers. A0001 b1 prefill uses 24 group submissions; baseline b8 profile records 24 acquisitions with 92.8 ms summed CPU wait and 24 copy submissions. Halving group count may reduce scheduling overhead, at the cost of larger first transfer and doubled slot capacity.
expected_bottleneck: per-group CPU producer and H2D coordination
change: Automatic pipeline uses minimum group size 2; explicit pipeline policy preserves requested group size. Bulk decode unchanged. Add configurable automatic minimum, default 2. No arithmetic change.

tradeoffs: Doubles per-slot host/GPU capacity with default prefetch depth, reduces memory saving while preserving offload placement.

CPU layout diagnostic suggests two-layer gather can cost more than two one-layer gathers; larger initial transfer may outweigh coordination savings. Test actual model rather than infer sums of overlapping spans.

decision: Clear prefill screen regressions against accepted A0001 at all three batches, larger cached buffers, and no compensating supported offload gain. Do not escalate.
